profile.headline: Electrical Engineer → Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer - Automation and Software Configuration
profile.summary: When given a problem I may be out of my depth in I don't retreat but I acknowledge that there is something new to be learned. My ability to learn through asking questions,  genuine curiosity and debugging skills in both machine and human interactions allows me to flourish in any environment. When I graduated from CSU in Electrical Engineering I found myself working for MiTek, where my computer programing skills would be tested. Although at times I felt like an imposter, I didn't let that discourage me. Now I am a Lead in my team and am working towards a Software Engineer II title. Although I may not have the skills initially asked of me, I trust my ability to learn and cooperate with those around me to become a valuable member of any team.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Automation and Software Configuration
positions.description: Design, develop, document, maintain, train, and execute complex Automated software on Dynamic platforms. Efficiency is the objective and Automation is the delivery system. By staying vigilant of areas that can leverage automation, the software that is delivered to our end-user is guaranteed to be of higher quality. The amount of time that is saved can then be allocated elsewhere in the development cycle. I like to consider my team as a small cog in a large machine, a cog that is paramount to the delivery and quality of software that gets out the door. The work my team does is a direct correlation to the effectiveness of the MiTek software suite.

positions.title: Guest Services Team Member
positions.description: As a Guest Services Team member I provided excellent customer service, guest information, acquainted guests with the campus, and served as a welcome ambassador for the university. Worked with professional conference services working with various campus partners, conference and event clients, and other CES professional staff on a daily basis to provide services for conference and event groups of all sizes. This position requires a commitment to customer service, strong oral and written communications, and the ability to work with a diverse array of groups, including international conferences.

company.name: Colorado State University Conference & Event Services

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: A Resident Assistant at CSU assists in supporting the Residence Life Mission: “To create safe and inclusive learning communities that support, challenge, and inspire all students to be ethical leaders and citizens in a diverse society”.  Resident Assistants also support Colorado State University’s Principles of Community: Inclusion, Integrity, Respect, Service, and Social Justice.  Finally, Resident Assistants support Residence Life’s Pillars: Connections, Leadership Development, Diversity and Social Justice, Learning, and Professional Development. I am expected to provide strategies for and assist residents with the transition, multicultural competence, learning, and ethical decision making.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student
positions.description: During my collegiate time at CSU, I have shown improvement intellectually and personally. The path that has brought me to where I am today is seen in my work ethic and my problem-solving skills. Being a first-generation student at CSU brings on a new world in which I had to adapt to my environment and push ahead setting new standards for what my family can do. I am proud to say that I am funding my own higher education in pursuit of a better life for me and my family. CSU will give me my Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering come Spring of 2018, but I will have given myself invaluable knowledge in interpersonal communications, an ambitious mentality, and a passion for self-improvement.

positions.title: Waiter
positions.description: As a waiter, I learned the importance of building short-term connections. My everyday duties consisted of giving genuine service to those I interacted with ensuring they wanted to return, wither it be for the food or the service. This was done by being prepared, efficient, and real with people. This position taught me that teamwork is essential and sometimes working alone will set you back. I excelled at my position to the point where I became the trainer of new employees. Being a waiter at Garcias Mexican restaurant also helped fund half of my education at CSU.

positions.title: Drywall Technician
positions.description:
Gained firsthand experience with construction site management, construction
safety, and the process of development. I had to calculate the number of supplies needed to complete a project and when on the site come up with ways of cutting drywall to ensure a perfect fit. This required that I was familiar with the permanent infrastructure and any of the future plans. I also aided in the translation of stud framework from blueprints to ground. This was an important job that required precision accuracy.

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.description: As a KFC shift supervisor, I ensured customer satisfaction and performed various administrative job duties. Primary responsibilities include setting schedules, hiring and training new employees, answering telephones, and overseeing restaurant protocol. Other specific job duties include delegating work, taking inventory, and placing food orders. Training for KFC managers involves verbal and visual demonstration as well as hands-on instruction. KFC sent me to leadership classes in order to better myself and lead a stronger team of individuals. I was the first point of contact when it came to customer complaints and managing money. This was my first official job.

honors.title: Member
honors.description: Mortar Board, Inc., is an honor society, is an association of individuals selected for distinguished ability and achievement in scholarship, leadership and service, which recognizing the advantages of a national union of senior honor societies, has formed a national honor society, whose purpose shall be to facilitate cooperation among those societies, to contribute to the self-awareness of its members, to promote equal opportunities among all peoples, to emphasize the advancement of the status of women, to support the ideals of the college or university, to advance a spirit of scholarship, to recognize and encourage leadership, to provide service, and to establish the opportunity for a meaningful exchange of ideas as individuals and as a group.
honors.issuer: Issued by Mortar Board Honor Society  · Apr 2017

honors.title: IEEE - HKN Honor Society
honors.description: IEEE-Eta Kappa Nu (IEEE-HKN), the honor society of IEEE, is dedicated to encouraging and recognizing individual excellence in education and meritorious work, in professional practice, and in any of the areas within the IEEE-designated fields of interest. Candidates are invited to join based on their academic ranking, their character, and attitude. The goal is to be the catalyst for the development of “The Complete Technical Professional.”
honors.issuer: Issued by Delta Pi Chapter at Colorado State University  · Jan 2017

volunteerExperiences.description: I started this program in an effort to bring representation to an underrepresented minority group of Latino engineers. Growing up Mexican-American in the U.S. has its challenges, one being a lack of role models that resemble you in the STEM field. Through my Robotics Club, I hope to direct students in a prosperous path to success through coding activities, robotic assembly, and problem-solving skills.

The protection and restoration of public lands cultivated an ethic of public stewardship. This program provides me and many others in Mortar Board Honor Society with impressive on-the-ground work and fostered a mindset of environmental responsibility. This was an incredible experience that began early in the morning with a two-hour drive to Colorado Springs. This helped facilitate great conversations and networking opportunities with fellow members. Once at the site, all members had to work as one ensuring that no one slacked off. Each task was inter-dependent of one another so it was important that everyone followed through. Overall a great experience being able to communicate with fellow members of the organization.

projects.title: Affected File Compare
projects.description: To ensure the quality and validity of the updates MiTek is producing, a tool was developed that would confirm an update install contained the files an Azure DevOps Task mentioned it would.

projects.title: Azure DevOps Migration
projects.description: Directed the effort of testing and migrating MiTek from Team Foundation Server to an Azure DevOps Server, which required cross-team communication and collaboration with Microsoft all while ensuring that builds, installations, and tests remained the same.

organizations.name: Colorado State University-Crew Rowing Team
organizations.description: If waking up at 4:00 am doesn't show dedication to an organization then I don't know what does. My senior year at CSU I decide to join the CSU Crew rowing team to challenge my self and improve my mental fortitude. This experience increased my discipline and forced me to manage my time wisely. I am currently a collegiate athlete while finishing off my last year as an Electrical Engineering student at CSU.  Rowing is unlike any other team sport, there is a total of 8 individuals but all must work in synchronous on a boat in to achieve the best results.

organizations.name: The International Electrical and Electronic Engineers (IEEE)
organizations.description: IEEE creates an environment where members collaborate on world‐changing technologies, from computing and sustainable energy systems to aerospace, communications, robotics, healthcare, and more. The IEEE Brand Identity Toolkit explains the basic usage rules for all corporate identity elements and how to utilize them to create a powerful and consistent communications piece.
